notes.text: Colophon 'Записано на урочищѣ Акониайке отъ чукчи Вателя.' is a one-line indented, left-set line closing no. 29, labelled MainZone-P by the rule. It is not centred (right inset ~300 px), so no ruling or description clearly puts it elsewhere; left as P. Editor may prefer MainZone-Other for colophons.
Notes in the second group open 'b) 1 (стр. 6).' and '2 (стр. 6).'; bands 9 and 10 start at those openers, as the ruling wants.
